```yaml
name: Build Daytona Snapshot

on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      snapshot_name:
        description: "Name of the built Daytona snapshot"
        value: ${{ jobs.build-snapshot.outputs.snapshot_name }}

jobs:
  build-snapshot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      snapshot_name: ${{ steps.build.outputs.snapshot_name }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          clean: true

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build Daytona snapshot
        id: build
        env:
          SANDBOX_ITERATE_REPO_REF: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Build the snapshot; the script should handle idempotency
          npm run build-snapshot
          echo "snapshot_name=iterate-sandbox-${{ github.sha }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
```
